level-1.$description: surface/level-1 on canvas (light). Raised decorative fills: tertiary/ghost buttons, badges, tags, containers, hover/active/selected/disabled chrome. Contrast: decorative chrome; not for state-conveying fills that need ≥3:1.

level-2.$description: surface/level-2 on canvas (light). Raised decorative fills: tertiary/ghost buttons, badges, tags, containers, hover/active/selected/disabled chrome. Contrast: decorative chrome; not for state-conveying fills that need ≥3:1.

level-3.$description: surface/level-3 on canvas (light). Raised decorative fills: tertiary/ghost buttons, badges, tags, containers, hover/active/selected/disabled chrome. Contrast: decorative chrome; not for state-conveying fills that need ≥3:1.

border.$description: surface/border on canvas (light). 1px structural lines (section rules, list separators that must meet ≥3:1). Keep separate from surface/control even when values match. Contrast: ≥3:1 against the context background.

field.$description: surface/field on canvas (light). Recessed field fill (brighter/deeper well, opposite of level). Bind Input, unchecked Checkbox, and unchecked Radio. Contrast: with text/primary (≥4.5:1).

field-hover.$description: surface/field-hover on canvas (light). Field hover wash. Contrast: with text/primary (≥4.5:1).

control.$description: surface/control on canvas (light). Filled shapes that convey state and need ≥3:1 — toggle off-track, progress track, slider track. Separate from surface/border (lines) so fills can diverge later.
